ios.desc:
Delve into the hidden depths of your personal Discogs.com collection with "Too Many Records!" for iOS. This app is the perfect companion for music enthusiasts who relish in the thrill of rediscovering their own meticulously curated collections.

With a simple tap, "Too Many Records!" selects a random record from your personal Discogs.com collection. Be it a beloved classic, a forgotten favorite, or an overlooked cassette, it's time to dust off your music and experience it anew.

Whether your collection boasts of vinyl records, CDs, or nostalgia-inducing cassettes, your next trip down memory lane is just a tap away. Use our filters to sift through specific genres, periods, or formats within your collection.

Reignite your passion for your music and keep the thrill of rediscovery alive with "Too Many Records!" for iOS. Uncover the hidden treasures within your collection and bask in the magic of music all over again!

This application uses Discogs’ API but is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Discogs. ‘Discogs’ is a trademark of Zink Media, LLC.
